# NWAA124 Extraction Notes

This external comparator is a semi-structured observability comparator, not a biological benchmark against SNU-668.

The useful information for this branch is methods-level and legend-level evidence about long-term density selection, mixed-population competition, carrying capacity, density-dependent morphology, and spatial behavior. Exact event-linked trajectories analogous to CLONEID passaging ledgers were not present in the extracted text.

Important limitations:

- Some methods numeric values appear in the DOCX as equation or embedded objects and did not survive text extraction. Those values are marked unavailable rather than reconstructed.
- Competition trajectories are presented in figure panels. This branch does not digitize figures, so it records qualitative or summary-level evidence only.
- The external data are HeLa r/K-selection data. They are used to compare observability and identifiability of a sparse published view, not to claim biological equivalence to SNU-668.
- Transcriptomic/genomic supplemental tables are not curated here because they do not directly resolve fixed fitness versus continuous crowding-history dependence.
